description: Search the Internet Archive, the Library of Congress and data.bnf.fr at once, in one answer.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-books

environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so an archive can always reach a human.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Widen the gap between two requests to one archive. Each archive keeps its own spacing when this is unset, and this can only make it wider.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request to an archive, in milliseconds. Default 45000.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries on rate limiting and transient failures. Default 3.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Set 0 to turn it off.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: BOOKS_LOG_LEVEL
